summary: Phase 15 3D replay + synthetic corridor model verified end-to-end (backend + frontend).  Backend (pytest): GET /api/routes/276dc5bb-.../memory?version=2 returns chair position (x=0.6, z=-5.0); GET /api/replays/{id}/points returns 462,480 bytes (38,540 points * 12 bytes); GET /api/replays/{id}/points?colors=true returns 115,620 bytes (38,540 * 3) — point/colour counts match; GET /api/attempts/48461db6-.../review/colors returns binary multiple-of-3 bytes.  Frontend @1920x1080 /demo v1 flow: Start replay → bv-replay-3dmode stage. 3D canvas (replay-scene wrap) is the main left element 1104/1920 ≈ 57.5% width; replay-frame-image on the right (360px); replay-synthetic-label='Synthetic demo (AI-generated images)'; replay-model-label='Synthetic 3D model'; replay-3d-legend present with 4 items; caption font-size=52px (>=48); document.documentElement.scrollHeight=1080 at start AND after reaching end state with replay-review-link visible.  Chair story — v1: caption 'Chair ahead, about 2 metres.' observed; replay-3d-summary 'Current checkpoint: Entrance. Cues so far: 5 spoken, 5 held back. Known objects: none.'  Latest (v2) via replay-on-latest radio: no 'chair' in any caption during full replay (seen: 'Door ahead, about 4.5 metres.' / 'On route.' / 'Checkpoint 1: Entrance.'); replay-3d-summary ends 'Known objects: chair.'; review page for v2 replay (/review/17970d8e-...) renders review-scene (3D), review-model-label='Synthetic 3D model', body contains 'Known: chair confirmed in v2', path-known-ca641109-... marker present, and 6 path-dot-* cue dots. Clicking the first path-dot adds class 'bv-tl-selected' to the matching timeline-item (dot↔timeline linking works).  Free look toggle: ON → hint 'Drag to orbit, pinch or scroll to zoom.'; OFF → 'Camera follows the walk. Turn on Free look to orbit.'  Reduced motion emulated → hint 'Fixed overview (reduced motion).'  Mobile 390×844: stacking order (y) = replay-scene (y=255) → replay-frame (y=782) → replay-caption (y=1033) → replay-counts (y=1420); no horizontal scroll.  Non-replay reviews: att-iiri 3D route /review/48461db6-... still shows review-scene (3D) count=1; Lobby att-oh0y (attempt a59b1526-...) stays 2D (review-scene count=0, SVG 2D path rendered). Created 12 replay attempts across testing; all deleted at end (12 attempts + 366 attempt_events removed). Demo data preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: Replay3D.jsx: useReducedMotion correctly subscribes/unsubscribes to matchMedia('prefers-reduced-motion: reduce') and gates CameraRig (follow = animate && !reduced && !freeLook) — confirmed via emulate_media('reduce') producing the fixed-overview hint.

ReplayScreen.Stage: Only renders the 3D branch (bv-replay-3dmode, replay-3d-summary) when s.three is truthy; 2D fallback (ReplayPath) is used otherwise. Verified: Lobby route attempt review stays 2D while synthetic corridor route is 3D.

Replay3D hint logic prioritises freeLook/!animate → orbit hint before reduced-motion → fixed-overview. If a user enables Free look under reduced motion, the orbit hint wins. Acceptable per spec wording ('prefers-reduced-motion -> fixed overview' refers to the default follow camera).

Scene3D testId='review-scene' is applied directly to the wrapper div (data-testid=review-scene). Replay3D uses `${testId}-wrap` on its outer div AND passes testId through to Scene3D (which sets data-testid=replay-scene on the canvas wrapper) — resulting in both replay-scene and replay-scene-wrap testids. Review path uses just review-scene (no -wrap). Fine, but inconsistent naming between replay/review.
replay-review-link appears only when s.review_path is set by backend; verified rendered when attempt ends.
Caption component: splits at first '. ' into primary+rest spans, uses aria-live=assertive role=status — correct for live updates to screen readers.
seed_data_creation: Created 12 replay attempts during testing (via /api/demo/replays and UI Start replay on v1 and latest). All 12 attempts and their 366 attempt_events deleted at end. Demo routes, exercises, synthetic recording, att-iiri and att-oh0y preserved.
